import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyAlternation
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# Cup cocycles of integral characters

Two integral characters of an abelian group define the inhomogeneous cup
cocycle `(s,t) ↦ f(s)g(t)` and hence a class in its actual second group
cohomology with trivial integral coefficients. Its alternation is the exterior
product of the two characters.

Reference: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, Chapter I, pp. 16-17.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U]

/-- The integral inhomogeneous cup cocycle of two characters. -/
def groupCharacterCupCocycle (f g : U →+ ℤ) :
    groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) := by
  refine ⟨fun p => f p.1.toAdd * g p.2.toAdd, ?_⟩
  apply (groupCohomology.mem_cocycles₂_iff _).mpr
  intro x y z
  change f (x.toAdd + y.toAdd) * g z.toAdd + f x.toAdd * g y.toAdd =
    f y.toAdd * g z.toAdd + f x.toAdd * g (y.toAdd + z.toAdd)
  simp only [map_add]
  ring

@[simp]
theorem groupCharacterCupCocycle_apply (f g : U →+ ℤ) (u v : U) :
    groupCharacterCupCocycle f g (Multiplicative.ofAdd u, Multiplicative.ofAdd v) =
      f u * g v := rfl

/-- The degree-two group cohomology class represented by the character cup
cocycle. -/
def groupCharacterCupClass (f g : U →+ ℤ) :
    groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) :=
  groupCohomology.H2π _ (groupCharacterCupCocycle f g)

/-- The cup of degree-one group cohomology classes, using the canonical
identification of trivial-coefficient first cohomology with characters. -/
def groupFirstCohomologyCup
    (c d : groupCohomology.H1 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) :
    groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) :=
  groupCharacterCupClass
    (((groupCohomology.H1IsoOfIsTrivial _).hom c).comp
      (AddEquiv.additiveMultiplicative U).symm.toAddMonoidHom)
    (((groupCohomology.H1IsoOfIsTrivial _).hom d).comp
      (AddEquiv.additiveMultiplicative U).symm.toAddMonoidHom)

/-- Alternation of the character cup class is the exterior product. -/
@[simp]
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_groupCharacterCupClass
    (f g : U →+ ℤ) (v : Fin 2 → U) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (groupCharacterCupClass f g) v =
      f (v 0) * g (v 1) - f (v 1) * g (v 0) := by
  rw [groupCharacterCupClass, groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_π]
  rfl

/-- The same exterior-product formula holds for actual degree-one group
cohomology classes under their canonical character identification. -/
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_groupFirstCohomologyCup
    (c d : groupCohomology.H1 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) (v : Fin 2 → U) :
    let f := (groupCohomology.H1IsoOfIsTrivial _).hom c
    let g := (groupCohomology.H1IsoOfIsTrivial _).hom d
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (groupFirstCohomologyCup c d) v =
      f (Additive.ofMul (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0))) *
          g (Additive.ofMul (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1))) -
        f (Additive.ofMul (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1))) *
          g (Additive.ofMul (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0))) := by
  exact groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_groupCharacterCupClass _ _ v

end Mumford.Analytic
